d:
"Some dogs arrive at Villalobos Rescue Center carrying stories of neglect, pain and hardship. Injured, sick, abandoned or struggling to survive on the streets, these pit bulls need more than a rescue. Under the care of Tia Torres and her team, they begin a journey towards healing, trust and a brighter future. Each dog has a different past, but all deserve the chance to experience love and kindness.
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 8, Episodes 8, 9, 3, 4, 2, 6 and 1, on Animal Planet India."
